title: Power Check
statement_md: A shield only resonates with charges that are an exact power of two ($1, 2, 4, 8, \dots$). For each charge, say whether it resonates.
input_md: The first line holds $q$. Each of the next $q$ lines holds one integer $x$.
output_md: For each $x$ print `YES` if $x$ is a power of two, otherwise `NO`.
hints: A power of two has exactly one set bit; x - 1 flips that bit and every bit below it.

import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline


def main():
    q = int(input())
    for _ in range(q):
        x = int(input())
        # your code here


main()

reference_solution:
import sys


def main():
    data = sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()
    q = int(data[0])
    out = []
    for x in data[1:1 + q]:
        v = int(x)
        out.append("YES" if v > 0 and v & (v - 1) == 0 else "NO")
    print("\n".join(out))


main()
